resources.string: Terms of Service\n\n Last Updated: January 2025\n\n 1. Acceptance of Terms>\n By accessing or using the Inhlwathi Bytes Peer Tutoring App ("the App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to all the terms, you may not use the App.\n\n 2. Description of Service\n The App provides a platform connecting students seeking academic assistance ("Students") with qualified peer tutors ("Tutors"). Services include but are not limited to scheduling sessions, communication tools, and payment processing.\n\n 3. User Accounts\n a. You must create an account to access most features of the App.\n b. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.\n c. You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account.\n\n 4. Tutor Responsibilities\n a. Tutors must provide accurate information about their qualifications.\n b. Tutors are responsible for the quality and appropriateness of their tutoring services.\n c. Tutors must maintain professional conduct at all times.\n\n 5. Student Responsibilities\n a. Students must provide accurate information about their academic needs.\n b. Students must treat Tutors with respect and professionalism.\n c. Students are responsible for payment of services rendered.\n\n 6. Cancellation Policy\n a. Sessions may be canceled up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.\n b. Late cancellations may incur fees as determined by the Tutor.\n\n 7. Intellectual Property\n All content provided through the App, including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, and software, is the property of Inhlwathi Bytes Inc. or its content suppliers.\n\n 8. Limitation of Liability\n Inhlwathi Bytes Inc. shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages resulting from the use of or inability to use the App.\n\n 9. Modifications to Terms\n We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the App after such changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.\n\n 10. Governing Law\n These Terms shall be governed by the laws of South Africa without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

Privacy Policy\n\n Last Updated: January 2025\n\n 1. Information We Collect\n a. Personal Information: When you register, we collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, and academic details.\n b. Payment Information: For transactions, we collect payment details which are processed securely by our third-party payment processors.\n c. Usage Data: We collect information about how you interact with our App, including session times, preferences, and device information.\n\n 2. How We Use Your Information\n a. To provide and maintain our service\n b. To notify you about changes to our service\n c. To allow you to participate in interactive features\n d. To provide customer support\n e. To gather analysis to improve our App\n f. To monitor usage of the App\n g. To detect and prevent fraud\n\n 3. Data Sharing and Disclosure\n a. Tutors and Students: Basic profile information is shared between matched Tutors and Students to facilitate sessions.\n b. Service Providers: We may employ third-party companies to facilitate our service, provide service on our behalf, or assist in analyzing how our service is used.\n c. Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.\n\n 4. Data Security\n We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.\n\n 5. Data Retention\n We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to provide you with our services and as described in this Privacy Policy.\n\n 6. Children\'s Privacy\n Our service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13.\n\n 7. Your Rights\n You have the right to:\n a. Access, update or delete your information\n b. Object to our processing of your personal data\n c. Request restriction of processing your personal data\n d. Request data portability\n e. Withdraw consent\n\n 8. Changes to This Policy\n We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.\n\n 9. Contact Us\n If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@inhlwathibytes.com.
